Paired source-driven foot-clearance experiments; raw traces stay local.

Source commands are regenerated in observer mode from recorded calibration
snapshots, then replayed with identical policy/geometry. Missing calibration
prefixes retain original commands and are explicitly counted. Snapshot starts
have cold policy history. This is not an exact reconstruction of camera fusion
or Quest dynamics. All variants also use the final sole/floor height guard.
